features.name: age_z_distance
features.description: Absolute z-scaled distance of age from the training-fold center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances age contribution in neighbor search and reduces raw-scale dominance.

features.name: demographic_code_center_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance to the training-fold center over z-scaled job, marital, and education codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an unsupervised prototype-distance axis for broad personal-profile similarity.

features.name: calendar_contact_center_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance to the training-fold center over z-scaled contact channel and calendar codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with comparable timing and channel context using a compact distance coordinate.

features.name: campaign_log_intensity
features.description: Log-compressed current-campaign contact count normalized by the training-fold maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps high-contact outliers from dominating while preserving outreach-effort ordering.

features.name: high_outreach_indicator
features.description: Binary flag for current-campaign contact count above one training-fold standard deviation over the center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a crisp neighborhood split for heavily contacted rows.

features.name: prior_recency_similarity
features.description: Bounded similarity from days since earlier contact; sentinel-like large gap receives 0 and very recent contact approaches 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves local geometry by converting sparse recency into a smooth similarity coordinate.

features.name: prior_activity_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized count of earlier contacts, capped by the training-fold maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves low-count differences while compressing repeated-contact outliers.

features.name: prior_activity_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for any recorded earlier contact.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates rows with prior interaction history from first-interaction rows.

features.name: credit_commitment_code_norm
features.description: Normalized aggregate of default, housing, and loan encoded fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact financial-profile coordinate so neighbors share similar credit-code patterns.

features.name: euribor_z_distance
features.description: Absolute z-scaled distance of euribor3m from the training-fold center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds normalized macro-rate context without letting its raw scale dominate neighbor distances.

features.name: employment_stability_semantic_score
features.description: Domain judgment on regularity and stability implied by job, age, education, and marital fields; 0 means unstable or unclear profile and 1 means very stable profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable semantic axis so neighbors with comparable employment profiles are closer even when raw codes are arbitrary.

features.name: contact_context_quality_semantic_score
features.description: Domain judgment of contact context using contact, month, day_of_week, campaign, pdays, and previous; 0 means unfavorable or saturated context and 1 means favorable and timely context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines timing, channel, saturation, and prior interaction cues into one bounded coordinate for local neighborhood grouping.
